key_insight: GDGraph converts radiology guidelines into executable decision graphs, improving case-evaluation accuracy while making decision paths traceable.
clinical_relevance: The approach could support more consistent guideline-based risk stratification and management planning for renal cysts, adnexal masses, and thyroid nodules.
method: An LLM partitions guidelines into sections and extracts decision subgraphs with linked definitions.
Related branches are compiled into an executable decision graph.
A fast model answers localized clinical questions while deterministic traversal resolves Boolean logic.
evidence_signal: Across 347 cases, GDGraph improved System One accuracy from 57.3% to 90.8%, exceeding retrieval-augmented GPT-4o (80.1%) and graph-guided GPT-4o with chain-of-thought (82.7%), with lower reported latency and cost.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish prospective clinical performance; guideline-compilation accuracy and generalizability require further validation.
paper_title: Radiology Guideline-derived Decision Graph for Efficient Clinical Decision Support
